page: UpCloud GPU-96xCPU-960GB-4xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 96 shared vCPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 10.0 GB of RAM per core.

The server is equipped with four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a total of 768 GB of GPU VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the presence of four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs and a substantial 960.0 GB memory footprint, this instance is designed for high-density parallel computing tasks. It is suited for large-scale machine learning model training, deep learning inference, and complex data science workloads. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the shared CPU allocation paired with high-end dedicated GPU accelerators represents a specialized resource tradeoff optimized for GPU-bound tasks rather than sustained CPU-heavy processing.
